criteria.description: Single-quoted literals use doubled single quotes as the only embedded-apostrophe representation.
criteria.evidence: src/sql/tokenizer.zig and src/sql/parser.zig focused tests cover O''Reilly, one decoded apostrophe, consecutive doubled pairs, and literal boundaries; `zig build test --summary all` passed 190/190 tests.
criteria.notes: Independently approved in WP01 review cycle 1.

criteria.description: The parser removes delimiters and decodes each doubled single quote exactly once while preserving all other bytes.
criteria.evidence: Parser exact-byte cases cover empty text, apostrophes, backslashes, newlines, UTF-8, comment markers, semicolons, and consecutive quote pairs; focused parser tests passed 37/37.
criteria.notes: The reviewer confirmed one allocator-owned linear decode with cleanup on error.

criteria.description: Backslashes inside single-quoted literals are ordinary data and never consume the following byte.
criteria.evidence: Tokenizer boundary tests cover interior and trailing backslashes plus a backslash immediately before the closing delimiter; focused tokenizer tests passed 9/9.
criteria.notes: Backslash skipping remains unchanged for the other pre-existing quoted forms.

criteria.description: SQL-looking punctuation remains data while a single-quoted literal is open and the first non-doubled quote closes it.
criteria.evidence: Native and ABI tests cover comment markers, predicates, semicolons, newlines, and exact token boundaries; ABI assertions preserve seven-row cardinality.
criteria.notes: Raw fixture bytes were inspected during independent review.

criteria.description: Unterminated single-quoted literals are rejected before execution without partial mutation.
criteria.evidence: Explicit token termination metadata covers opening-only, ordinary-byte EOF, trailing-backslash EOF, and doubled-pair EOF; ABI rejection cases return parse_error with null results and unchanged row count.
criteria.notes: Termination is not inferred from the final lexeme byte.

criteria.description: Native tokenizer and parser regressions cover the complete required literal matrix.
criteria.evidence: `zig test src/sql/tokenizer.zig` passed 9/9 and `zig test src/sql/parser.zig` passed 37/37 after chronological baseline-red evidence was recorded.
criteria.notes: The review receipt audits the red evidence and distinguishes one corrected harness-only false red.

criteria.description: The public C ABI inserts and retrieves required text exactly and proves statement scope remains unchanged.
criteria.evidence: tests/integration/abi_acceptance.zig covers exact returned bytes, seven-row cardinality, parse-error/null results, and zero mutation through exported ABI functions; full suite passed.
criteria.notes: No ABI signature, ownership, or version changed.

criteria.description: Hostile-case text remains byte-identical after checkpoint, close, and reopen.
criteria.evidence: The ABI acceptance lifecycle checkpoints, closes, reopens, then rechecks exact bytes and seven-row cardinality; `zig build test --summary all` passed 190/190 tests.
criteria.notes: Persistence and storage format are unchanged.

criteria.description: Existing double-quoted string and backtick-identifier behavior remains unchanged.
criteria.evidence: Focused compatibility tests prove the pre-existing backslash-skipping boundaries for double quotes and backticks; the full 190-test suite passed.
criteria.notes: The production condition changes backslash treatment only when the delimiter is a single quote.
